findings.evidence: Roadmap lines 359–363 explicitly require the decomposition “as unitary G×G-representations” and its isotypic projectors. The theorem at lines 422–425 is only an `IsHilbertSum` of linear isometries, while the module docstring lines 52–55 explicitly says the G×G identification is not proved.
findings.fix: First define the left-right G×G actions on `L²(G)` and on `Vπ ⊗ Vπ*`/Hilbert-Schmidt endomorphisms, then prove the block equivalences and assembled Hilbert-sum equivalence intertwine those actions (and identify the blocks via the isotypic projectors).
findings.issue: `isHilbertSum_euclideanSpace_peterWeylBlock` is presented as `L²(G) ≅ ⨁̂ End(Vπ)`, but its summands are bare Euclidean coordinate spaces and its maps carry no G×G actions or intertwining laws; translation stability of the ranges does not establish the advertised isotypic decomposition.

summary: The claimed isotypic decomposition is only a Hilbert-space coordinate decomposition; it omits the load-bearing G×G representation statement required by the roadmap.
